# Markdown Textarea Editor

## Summary
The edit-format component that ships inside the field — a multi-line editor whose read formats render the markdown. Declaring
the field is all it takes; the editor renders wherever the card is edited.

## Example
```ts
import MarkdownField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/markdown';

@field value = contains(MarkdownField);
```
Custom editors replace it by overriding the field's `edit` format; the
value-attribute + input-event binding pattern applies.
